name: acord
label: ACORD (Insurance)
description: Association for Cooperative Operations Research — global insurance standard

table_notes.acord_party: Any entity (person or organization) that participates in an insurance transaction — insurer, insured, claimant, agent, or broker.
table_notes.acord_policy: Master insurance contract record linking insurer and insured parties with coverage period, line of business, and total premium.
table_notes.acord_coverage: Individual coverage component within a policy, defining what is covered, up to what limit, and at what deductible and premium.
table_notes.acord_risk: Insured object or exposure (property, vehicle, person, liability) attached to a policy with its assessed value and attributes.
table_notes.acord_claim: Loss event reported against a policy, tracking dates, cause, financial reserves, paid amounts, and adjudication status.

acord_party.name: id
acord_party.description: Surrogate primary key for the party record

acord_party.name: party_type
acord_party.description: Role of this party: Person, Organization, Insurer, Agent, Broker, etc.

acord_party.name: full_name
acord_party.description: Legal full name of the individual or organization

acord_party.name: tax_id
acord_party.description: Government tax identifier (SSN, EIN, or foreign equivalent)

acord_party.name: date_of_birth
acord_party.description: Date of birth for individuals; used for age-rated underwriting

acord_party.name: gender
acord_party.description: Gender for actuarial rating purposes (M/F/Unknown or expanded codes)

acord_party.name: address
acord_party.description: Structured mailing/physical address: {street, city, state, postal_code, country_code}

acord_party.name: communication
acord_party.description: Contact channels: {phone, email, fax} keyed by communication type

acord_policy.name: id
acord_policy.description: UUID primary key; stable reference used across systems

acord_policy.name: policy_number
acord_policy.description: Carrier-assigned unique policy identifier printed on declarations page

acord_policy.name: policy_type
acord_policy.description: High-level policy classification: Personal, Commercial, Life, Health, etc.

acord_policy.name: line_of_business

acord_policy.name: insurer_id

acord_policy.name: insured_id
acord_policy.description: References acord_party — the named insured on this policy

acord_policy.name: status
acord_policy.description: Policy lifecycle state: Active, Expired, Cancelled, Pending, Lapsed

acord_policy.name: effective_date

acord_policy.name: expiration_date
acord_policy.description: Date coverage ends; end of the policy term

acord_policy.name: total_premium
acord_policy.description: Total written premium for the full policy term in the policy currency

acord_policy.name: currency
acord_policy.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this policy

acord_coverage.name: id
acord_coverage.description: Surrogate primary key for the coverage record

acord_coverage.name: policy_id
acord_coverage.description: References acord_policy — the policy this coverage belongs to

acord_coverage.name: coverage_type
acord_coverage.description: Human-readable coverage name: Bodily Injury, Property Damage, Collision, etc.

acord_coverage.name: coverage_code
acord_coverage.description: ACORD coverage code (from ACORD code list, e.g. BI, PD, COMP, COLL)

acord_coverage.name: limit_amount

acord_coverage.name: deductible_amount
acord_coverage.description: Amount the insured must pay out-of-pocket before coverage applies

acord_coverage.name: premium
acord_coverage.description: Written premium allocated to this specific coverage component

acord_coverage.name: terms
acord_coverage.description: Coverage-specific terms and endorsements: {sublimits, exclusions, conditions, endorsement_codes}

acord_risk.name: id
acord_risk.description: Surrogate primary key for the risk record

acord_risk.name: policy_id
acord_risk.description: References acord_policy — the policy insuring this risk

acord_risk.name: risk_type
acord_risk.description: Category of insured object: Property, Vehicle, Person, Liability, etc.

acord_risk.name: description
acord_risk.description: Free-text description of the insured object or exposure

acord_risk.name: location
acord_risk.description: Physical location of the risk: {street, city, state, postal_code, country_code, lat, lng}

acord_risk.name: value
acord_risk.description: Stated or appraised value of the insured risk in the policy currency

acord_risk.name: attributes
acord_risk.description: Risk-type-specific underwriting attributes: e.g. {year, make, model, vin} for vehicles or {construction, stories, year_built} for property

acord_claim.name: id
acord_claim.description: UUID primary key; stable claim reference across adjusting systems

acord_claim.name: claim_number
acord_claim.description: Carrier-assigned unique claim identifier used in correspondence

acord_claim.name: policy_id

acord_claim.name: claimant_id

acord_claim.name: loss_date

acord_claim.name: report_date

acord_claim.name: cause_of_loss

acord_claim.name: total_incurred

acord_claim.name: paid_to_date

acord_claim.name: reserve_amount
acord_claim.description: Current actuarial reserve set aside for future payments on this claim

short_description: Association for Cooperative Operations Research — global insurance standard
long_description: ACORD (Association for Cooperative Operations Research and Development) is the foundational data standard for the global insurance industry, covering P&C, life, health, and commercial lines. The schema models the complete insurance lifecycle: parties, policies, coverages, risks, claims, and payments — matching the ACORD 1/2 form data elements used in US commercial insurance.
when_to_use: Use for any insurance management system, agency portal, or insurtech application. ACORD standards are implemented by 90%+ of US insurance carriers and are widely used globally. Required for carrier data feeds, comparative rating platforms, and state DOI reporting submissions.
